_note: Magnetic field source: a loop of wire (or a straight wire, or a two-core mains cable) carrying the circuit's audio-frequency current, whose stray field a hand-wound pickup coil overhears. 2-terminal: a, b. Engine (bw-board induction_loop, src/magnetic-coupling.js): shape loop (turns, radiusM; on-axis field muN r^2/2(r^2+d^2)^1.5), wire (mu/2 pi d) or cable (spacingMm; mu s/2 pi (d^2+s^2/4)); pickup names an air_coil, coupled by M = N2 pi r2^2 (B/I) cos(angleDeg). Its control is the distance (0 = farCm 30, 1 = nearCm 1; rest params.position 0.5). Reports amps, distanceCm, mutualH, k.
